title: A familiar conversation, a new connection
summary: The first public Android companion for talking to Instinct through email. Your phone connects directly to Gmail, with a messaging interface and no relay server.
notes: Read your existing Instinct emails as chronological chat bubbles.
Send UTF-8 messages with the original email subject and reply headers.
Connect your own Gmail account and Instinct email address.
Keep credentials, messages, and drafts encrypted on the device with Android Keystore.
Preserve uncertain sends without automatically retrying, and reconcile them during sync.
Refresh while open and receive periodic background reply notifications.
Read original emails, open links and attachments in Gmail, and share text into the composer.
Open this public DevLog directly from the app's connection settings.
Switch between light and dark themes, with matching system bars and native dialogs.
